sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners at length and learned AGA who appears on behalf of State-respondents.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of the impugned FIR dated 18.9.2022 registered as FIR No. 662 of 2022 under Sections363, 366, 376 IPC and Sections 5/6 of POCSO Act at P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Raebareli and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners pursuant to the impugned FIR.
Ms. X Victim Of Fir No.-662/2022 And ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190164795/
1
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioner no. 1 out of her own free will got married to the petitioner no. 2.
Petitioner nos. 3, 4 and 5 are the relatives of the petitioner no. 2 and all of them originally belong to District Jalore, Rajasthan.
They had all worked as labourers in Raebareli at the time when the petitioner no. 2 fell in love with the petitioner no. 1 and ran away with her and got married.
Now they have a small daughter.

The opposite party no. 4, father of the petitioner no. 1 has lodged the impugned FIR initially under Sections 363 and 366 IPC but later on Sections 376 IPC and 5/6 of POCSCO Act have also been added at P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Raebareli.

It has further been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that there is full hope of an amicable settlement between the parties as the father of the petitioner no. 1 would certainly not want the life of the petitioner no. 1 be spoiled, if the petitioner no. 2 and his family members are arrested and sent to jail.
Learned AGA shall inform the Station House Officer, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Raebareli to ensure the presence of the opposite party no. 4 in this Court on 1.8.2023.
The petitioner nos. 1 and 2 shall also remain present before this Court on the next date of listing.

Accordingly, we direct that till the next date of listing or till filing of police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C., whichever is earlier, the arrest of the petitioners no. 2 to 5 in connection with the impugned First Information Report shall remain stayed.
